shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English, used as a 'listen and find' game scene: the learner hears a sentence and taps the matching subject. Natural everyday photographic detail, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. Every subject named below must be instantly recognizable on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.edit: This is an edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph. Change only what the instruction names.

assets.item: The husband and the wife are talking. / The person is sitting. / The son and the dog are running. / The daughter and a friend are playing.
assets.prompt: ONE WIDE PHOTO OF A FAMILY GARDEN PARTY on one sunny lawn, balloons and a long table far behind. Exactly six people and one dog, spread naturally across the lawn from left to right: a HUSBAND AND WIFE of about forty, both wearing wedding rings, standing close together and TALKING face to face; an older man SITTING alone on a wooden garden bench; a boy of about ten RUNNING across the grass next to a running brown dog; two girls of about eight PLAYING together with a hoop. Nobody else is in the photo. Every person is fully visible and plain at phone size. This is ONE single continuous photograph taken with one camera from one position: NOT a collage, NOT a grid, NOT side-by-side panels, no seams or dividing lines; the same lawn and the same background run continuously behind every person, and the people stand at slightly different distances from the camera like in a real scene. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.
